title: "Files and Data Manipulation"

## Reading and Writing Files

### Text Files

::: {.cell execution_count=1}
``` {.julia .cell-code}
# Writing to a file
open("example.txt", "w") do f
    write(f, "Hello, Julia!")
end

# Reading from a file
content = read("example.txt", String)
println(content)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
Hello, Julia!
```
:::
:::



### CSV Files

::: {.cell execution_count=0}
``` {.julia .cell-code}
using CSV, DataFrames

# Read CSV
df = CSV.read("data.csv", DataFrame)

# Write CSV
CSV.write("output.csv", df)
```
:::



## DataFrames

DataFrames are tabular data structures similar to pandas in Python or data.frames in R.

### Creating DataFrames

::: {.cell execution_count=1}
``` {.julia .cell-code}
using DataFrames

# Create from columns
df = DataFrame(
    name = ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
    age = [25, 30, 35],
    city = ["Helsinki", "Espoo", "Tampere"]
)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1}
```{=tex}
\begin{tabular}{r|ccc}
	& name & age & city\\
	\hline
	& String & Int64 & String\\
	\hline
	1 & Alice & 25 & Helsinki \\
	2 & Bob & 30 & Espoo \\
	3 & Charlie & 35 & Tampere \\
\end{tabular}
```
:::
:::



### Basic Operations

::: {.cell execution_count=1}
``` {.julia .cell-code}
# Select columns
df[:, :name]
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1}
```
3-element Vector{String}:
 "Alice"
 "Bob"
 "Charlie"
```
:::
:::



::: {.cell execution_count=1}
``` {.julia .cell-code}
# Filter rows
filter(row -> row.age > 25, df)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1}
```{=tex}
\begin{tabular}{r|ccc}
	& name & age & city\\
	\hline
	& String & Int64 & String\\
	\hline
	1 & Bob & 30 & Espoo \\
	2 & Charlie & 35 & Tampere \\
\end{tabular}
```
:::
:::



::: {.cell execution_count=1}
``` {.julia .cell-code}
# Add new column
df.country = ["Finland", "Finland", "Finland"]
df
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1}
```{=tex}
\begin{tabular}{r|cccc}
	& name & age & city & country\\
	\hline
	& String & Int64 & String & String\\
	\hline
	1 & Alice & 25 & Helsinki & Finland \\
	2 & Bob & 30 & Espoo & Finland \\
	3 & Charlie & 35 & Tampere & Finland \\
\end{tabular}
```
:::
:::



### Grouping and Aggregation

::: {.cell execution_count=1}
``` {.julia .cell-code}
using Statistics

# Group by and summarize
gdf = groupby(df, :country)
combine(gdf, :age => mean => :avg_age)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1}
```{=tex}
\begin{tabular}{r|cc}
	& country & avg\_age\\
	\hline
	& String & Float64\\
	\hline
	1 & Finland & 30.0 \\
\end{tabular}
```
:::
:::



## Working with Geoscientific Data

### Loading Geophysical Data

::: {.cell execution_count=0}
``` {.julia .cell-code}
using DelimitedFiles

# Read space-delimited data
data = readdlm("gravity_data.txt")

# Extract columns
x, y, gz = data[:, 1], data[:, 2], data[:, 3]
```
:::



### NetCDF Files

::: {.cell execution_count=0}
``` {.julia .cell-code}
using NCDatasets

# Read NetCDF
ds = Dataset("climate_data.nc")
temp = ds["temperature"][:]
close(ds)
```
:::
